description: Monthly update of the base images the reconciler runs (D109). Only packages/manifest/src/platform.ts is watched: one grouped pull request on the first of the month, merged by Renovate when CI is green, on a weekday between 9:00 and 17:00 (Paris). Majors wait for the owner; Postgres majors are never proposed (D29).

packageRules.description: A major version waits for a session with the owner.
Postgres majors go through dump and restore, never through Renovate (D29).
